{{Quote|Now the Council names you Barsen'thor, Warden of the Order.|Jedi Master Syo Bakarn, granting the title coined by Lorjan Sakku's Master, to worthy recipient|<ref name="Vivicar Awaits">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Vivicar Awaits|Tython}}</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] was the '''Jedi Master''' of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Lorjan Sakku]] thousands of years before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When her Padawan sacrificed his own life in order to redeem his maddened brother [[Lyhesh Sakku|Lyhesh]], the Jedi Master recognized her fallen student's effort by naming him "[[Barsen'thor]]," which translated to "Warden of the Order" from her native [[Cerean (language)|Cerean language]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There's a title reserved for the most prestigious among us, whose wisdom and skill safeguard the galaxy. It hasn't been bestowed in thousands of years.|audio=TheresaTitle.flac|Master [[Jaric Kaedan]], on the title of Barsen'thor, which was coined by Lorjan Sakku's Master|<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was active in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="TORE" /> [[Millennium/Legends|thousands]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="Date">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Vivicar Awaits|Tython}} establishes that the title of [[Barsen'thor]] had not been bestowed in [[Millennium/Legends|thousands]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] when it is awarded to the [[The Barsen'thor|third recipient]] at the height of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. These thousands of years reference the tenure of [[Barsen'thor (second)|the second Barsen'thor]], while [[Lorjan Sakku]]'s training under his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] must have taken place even earlier.</ref> Having attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], the Cerean took a young man named [[Lorjan Sakku]] as her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] him in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. While Lorjan was training under the Cerean Master, his brother and fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lyhesh Sakku|Lyhesh]] was [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] in a deliberate attempt on his life. Lyhesh survived, but he became unhinged as a result of the attack, falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="TORE" />

Recognizing the mad Jedi as a major threat to the stability of the entire Order, Lorjan sought out and confronted his brother. The Cerean's Padawan managed to redeem Lyhesh, but at the [[Death/Legends|cost]] of his own life. Recognizing the selfless efforts of her late Padawan, the Jedi Master posthumously named Lorjan "[[Barsen'thor]]," meaning "Warden of the Order" in her native [[Cerean (language)|Cerean language]]. The Jedi Order adopted the title as an official ceremonial rank, awarding it only to exceptional individuals<ref name="TORE" /> who displayed great wisdom and skill in service of the Order.<ref name="Vivicar Awaits">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Vivicar Awaits|Tython}}</ref> Some [[Time/Legends|time]] after Lorjan's death,<ref name="TORE" /> a [[Barsen'thor (second)|second Barsen'thor]] was proclaimed by the Jedi Order, and a [[The Barsen'thor|third individual]] was deemed worthy of the title millennia later, during the Cold War.<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" />

==Personality and traits==
The Jedi Master was affected by the death of her Padawan, deeming that sacrifice worthy of the title of Barsen'thor. That title would continue to see use among the Jedi for generations to come, well into the era of the Cold War.<ref name="TORE" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Cerean was sensitive to the Force and had attained the rank of Jedi Master by the time she took Lorjan as her Padawan.<ref name="TORE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cerean Jedi Master was mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', which provided context for the title of Barsen'thor,<ref name="TORE" /> first featured in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" />
